_comment: The fit's analysis record: what was measured on which sample, its metadata, the raw data it came from, and the flrCIF export.
title: Info

sections.title: Analysis
sections.description: What this analysis is: its id, type, sample and conditions.
Analysis id (read-only), analysis type, the sample (pick a stored one or type a new id; the button makes a new UUID) and free-text sample and condition details.

sections.title: Metadata
sections.description: Key / value metadata of this analysis, keys from the mmCIF catalogue or your own.
One row per key. Double-click a cell to type in it; pick a row to choose its key from the catalogue below.

columns.title: key
columns.tooltip: The metadata key (an mmCIF item or your own).

sections.label: Key
sections.description: The picked row's key, from the mmCIF catalogue (type to filter it).
What the picked key means (from the dictionary).

sections.title: External data
sections.description: References to the raw data this analysis came from (photon streams).
One row per external file. Double-click a cell to type a path / URL or its format.

columns.title: file path / URL
columns.tooltip: Where the raw data is: a local path or a URL.

sections.description: Add or remove external data references.

buttons.description: Add an empty row to type a path or URL into.

sections.description: How to add references, and where detector / channel information goes.

sections.title: Export
sections.description: The analysis as flrCIF (mmCIF): preview, copy or save.
Compute, copy or save the mmCIF.

buttons.description: Compute the full mmCIF preview, with the fit's curves embedded.

buttons.label: Copy to clipboard
buttons.description: Copy the preview's text to the clipboard.

buttons.label: Save to file…
buttons.description: Save the preview's text as an .cif file.

sections.description: The mmCIF that would be exported (read-only; select and copy as in an editor).
